prompts.actions:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for an existing Godot 16x16 pastel pixel farming game. Reference images are STYLE AND CHARACTER IDENTITY references, not edit targets. Make a NEW transparent PNG sprite sheet, 1024x2048 pixels, EXACTLY 4 equal columns by 8 equal rows, each cell 256x256 rendered as a nearest-neighbor enlargement of a 32x32 logical pixel cell (8x8 blocks). No labels, no grid lines, no scenery, no ground, no text, no shadows outside sprites. Match the reference tiny cream-yellow biped with muted lavender-purple contour, square head with two tiny ear tips, pale face and simple little body, NO clothes, NO human farmer, no added accessories. Body about 16 logical pixels high, identical size in every cell. Character feet fixed at local logical pixel (16,24) in all cells, tool can occupy remaining area.
Rows 1-4: HOE farming animation, facing down, up, left, right respectively. Tool is a LONG brown shaft with SMALL PERPENDICULAR flat dull gray hoe blade, NOT an axe. Four columns: ready holding shaft; lift hoe above shoulders; strike DOWN INTO THE GROUND 12 logical pixels in front of feet while leaning forward; withdraw toward body. Strong vertical overhead-to-ground motion.
Rows 5-8: AXE chopping animation, facing down, up, left, right respectively. Tool is a shorter brown handle with a BROAD wedge shaped dull gray AXE head. Four columns: ready two-handed; pull axe BACK TO THE SIDE at shoulder height; swing SIDEWAYS INTO A TREE TRUNK in front at waist height; follow through sideways. Strong horizontal/diagonal chopping arc, VISIBLY DIFFERENT from hoe digging. Keep exact same character identity and palette throughout all 32 poses. Flat limited muted palette, hard square pixels, no antialiasing, no gradients, no white outlines, genuine transparent empty background. This atlas will be sliced uniformly: make layout exact and leave 2 logical pixels empty padding within every cell.
prompts.crops:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production crop growth sprite atlas for an existing 16x16 pastel pixel Godot farming game. Existing image reference is STYLE reference only. NEW transparent PNG 1536x1024, EXACTLY 6 equal columns and 4 equal rows of 256x256 cells; each cell is a 32x32 logical pixel sprite enlarged by nearest neighbor 8x, sprites about 12-20 logical pixels, baseline fixed at logical (16,26). No text, no labels, no grid, no background, no ground tiles. Strict grid, each object isolated inside its cell with generous transparent padding.
Rows in order: carrot; white turnip with lavender shoulder; tomato bush; golden wheat cluster. Columns in each row: 1 planted seeds as two brown seeds on tiny brown mound, 2 small two-leaf sprout, 3 leafy juvenile plant, 4 almost mature plant with a visible small crop, 5 fully mature harvest-ready plant, 6 standalone harvested item (carrot/turnip/tomato/wheat sheaf). Tomato stages develop from seedling into small supported bush; wheat stages grow from grasslike sprout to golden heads. Same cultivar and perspective across a row, same root location. Match reference muted sage green foliage, golden cream highlights, dusty rose tomatoes, ochre carrot, soft purple-brown contours. Crisp chunky pixel art with few flat colors, no dithering, NO smooth shading, no high detail, no glow. Game-ready transparent alpha.
prompts.items:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production inventory item sprite atlas for a muted pastel 16x16 pixel farming game. Reference images are STYLE reference only. NEW transparent PNG 1024x1024, EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, each cell 256x256 enlarged nearest-neighbor from logical 32x32. Each sprite compact about 16-20 logical pixels, centered, generous transparent padding, no labels/grid/text/scene/background.
Row1: carrot seed packet (kraft envelope with clear orange carrot picture and green sprout, NO text); turnip seed packet (white-purple turnip picture); tomato seed packet (red tomato picture); wheat seed packet (golden wheat picture).
Row2: stack of three chopped wood logs; two gray stones; bundle of green plant fiber; small tied fertilizer sack with leaf symbol.
Row3: harvested carrot; harvested white-purple turnip; red tomato; tied golden wheat sheaf.
Row4: single gold coin with a leaf imprint; small stack of gold coins; full white cloth produce shipping sack; simple closed wooden farm storage chest with purple-brown edges.
Match original game palette: pale yellow, sage green, dusty terracotta brown, muted gray metal, lavender-purple dark outline. Simple silhouettes clear when reduced to 16px. Hard square pixel clusters, no antialiasing, no smooth gradient, no 3D rendering, NO dark black outlines. Actual alpha transparency.
prompts.actions_correction:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: corrected production sprite atlas. Edit target: the provided action sprite sheet. Preserve EXACTLY its 4-column 8-row grid, character design, cream-yellow / lavender pixel palette and body size, no labels, actual transparent background.
Correct tool motion and direction while keeping the poses distinct:
TOP FOUR ROWS are HOE facing down, up, left, right. Bottom FOUR rows are AXE facing down, up, left, right. Four columns are ready / windup / impact / recovery.
CRITICAL CORRECTIONS: In the UP-facing rows (row 2 and row 6), the character is viewed from BEHIND. In column 3 impact, tool head MUST be ABOVE the character's HEAD toward the TOP of that cell, pointing away from the viewer, never below its feet. In the UP-facing hoe row, extend the shaft upward from the hands, dig soil ahead of the head. Up-facing axe goes above the head too.
AXE rows must be a SIDEWAYS chop with a horizontal brown shaft in column 3, broad gray wedge blade at its outer end, and bent knees. For DOWN-facing axe the horizontal shaft crosses at WAIST level left-to-right, the blade extends to the RIGHT at waist level, never hangs below feet. For LEFT-facing axe impact the blade extends far LEFT at waist level. For RIGHT-facing axe impact blade extends far RIGHT at waist level. Keep hoe a vertical LONG handled downward DIGGING motion; keep axe a shorter handled horizontal CHOPPING motion. Do not depict axes as hoes, do not repeat the hoe impact poses for axe.
Maintain crisp hard pixel edges, isolated sprites, equal cell layout, NO smudges, NO colored fringe or stray red/magenta pixels. No background or opaque blocks, true transparent alpha. Canvas same aspect 1:2, ideally 1024x2048. Each character's feet remain on same baseline across four columns.
